text: Shadowclaw is a rare mob saber cat found in Darkshore. He is normally stealthed and is located north of the Ruins of Auberdine, in Withering Thicket. Use of cheap AoE skills such as Arcane Explosion can help when seeking him out. It is also present during the Battle for Darkshore.
The Shadowglen Trolls were a group of forest trolls under the rule of Chieftain Krag'jin who used giant sea turtles in their fighting forces.

:Were you looking for the Shadowfang Keep instance in Silverpine Forest or the Shadowfang pack of worgen? __NOTOC__ Shadowfang is a one-hand sword with a Shadow damage proc and additional Shadow damage that is a zone drop in (appropriately enough) Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest.
Shadowhorn Stags are stags located in eastern Ashenvale forest.
Shadowcloth is a high level cloth crafted by tailors. It is used to create set items with bonuses to shadow and frost spells.

The Shadoweave Armor set is a collection of violet-colored cloth items. They are not considered to be a true set and there are no bonuses gain if you wear more than one or all of the items in this set. This collection is best suited for warlocks shadow priests.
The Shadowforge Commander is a rare mob Dark Iron dwarf found inside Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave is a Forsaken located in Blackrock Depths. Before the Cataclysm, she could be found in Kargath in Badlands.
Shadowmaw Panthers are panthers found in Northern Stranglethorn. Unlike other Stranglethorn Panthers, they use a form of Stealth and hence can be quite difficult to track down.

Shadoweave Cloth is not available in-game. This is an acknowledged bug by Blizzard, even though there was an engineering recipe that lists this as an ingredient. It is likely it was replaced by Shadowcloth during development of The Burning Crusade.
The Shadowforge Bushmaster is a rare drop from creatures in Uldaman. It is valued most by "twink" characters in the 30-39 PvP bracket.
Shadowbrim Travel Hat is a quest reward from Disrupt Their Reinforcements.
Shadowcast Tunic is a quest reward from Drill the Drillmaster and The Foot of the Citadel.
Shadowmaster's Boots drop from Mother Shahraz in the Black Temple.
Shadowmaw Claws drops from Elder Shadowmaw Panthers and Shadowmaw Panthers in Stranglethorn Vale.
Shadowcaster Maces drop from Shadowpine Shadowcaster in the Ghostlands.
Shadowforge Ruffians are Dark Iron dwarves found in the Badlands and Uldaman.
Shadowforge Diggers are Dark Iron dwarves found in the Badlands and Uldaman.
Shadowforge Surveyors are Dark Iron dwarves found in the Badlands and Uldaman.
__NOTOC__ Shadowmaster Grieve is an orc found inside the barracks in Grangol'var Village in Terokkar Forest. He's the Shadow Council's leader at the village.

Shadowforge Senators are members of the Shadowforge Senate that can be found in the Imperial Seat in Blackrock Depths. As members of the Senate, they are part of the body governing the Dark Iron nation, along with Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
Shadowed Gauntlets of Paroxysm are epic leather gloves designed for Melee DPS classes.
This is a page listing loot to be found in Shadowfang Keep (Classic). For information about the instance itself, see Shadowfang Keep (Classic).
The Shadowed Spirits were summoned in the Great Ossuary of Scholomance by the Divination Scryer. They were especially susceptible to Seal of Light.
Two Shadowforge Gates can be found in the Detention Block of Blackrock Depths.
Shadowfang Wolfguard were worgen located in Shadowfang Keep. They summoned Wolfguard Worgs to aid them.
Shadowforge Torches drop from or are pickpocketed from Shadowforge Flame Keepers in the Lyceum of Blackrock Depths.
Shadowdodger (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating General Vezax without any raid member being hit by Shadow Crash on 10-player mode.
Shadowfang Whitescalps were worgen encountered in Shadowfang Keep.
Shadowfang Ragetooth were worgen encountered in Shadowfang Keep.
__NOTOC__ Shadowfang Darksoul are worgen found in Shadowfang Keep.
Shadowfang Glutton were worgen you will first encounter in Shadowfang Keep.

The Shadowfang pack were a group of worgen residing at Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. As of the Cataclysm, they have seemingly disappeared. They were most likely killed off by the forces of the Forsaken (who seized control of Silverpine Forest). Another possibility is that they were cleared out by the undead minions of Lord Godfrey and his allies, Baron Ashbury and Lord Walden, the new occupants of the keep.
Shadowfrost Shards are splinters from the Lich King's throne that scattered throughout the citadel when Arthas Menethil struck Ner'zhul's prison with Frostmourne to release his soul.
Shadowforge Flame Keepers can be found in the Lyceum in Blackrock Depths. The torches they drop are required to light the two braziers in order to open the doors to the Iron Hall.
Shadowhoof Assassins are satyr found on the stairs to the Black Temple.
Shadowforge Chanters are dark iron dwarves located inside Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Shadowforge Darkweavers are Dark Iron dwarves located east of Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Shadowforge Tunnelers are Dark Iron dwarves located east of Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Shadowforge Warriors are dark iron dwarves located inside Angor Fortress in the Badlands.
Shadowhide Boots is a quest reward from Shadowhide Extinction.
Shadowlurk Ridge, located in Felwood, lies near the Ruins of Constellas. It is home to a swarm of imps that stretch the entire length of the area.
Shadowdeep Reagents is a reagent shop found in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
Shadowfang Keep Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Shadowfang Keep instance while in a guild group.
Shadowleaf Bow is a quest reward from Might of the Sentinels.
Shadowmaster Sydow is a mogu located at Mistfall Village of Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shadowfae Tricksters are sprites located on Windward Isle in the The Jade Forest.
Shadowfae Madcap is a sprite located on Windward Isle in the Jade Forest.
Shadowmancer Selenora is a level 90 elite Forsaken warlock found conversing with Quirox the Illiterate under the stairway at Domination Point's keep in the Krasarang Wilds.

This item is crafted by Leatherworkers with a skill level of 575. Pattern: Shadowleather Leg Armor is sold by Jaluu the Generous in Mogu'shan Palace in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The pattern costs . You must be with the Golden Lotus to purchase this pattern.

Shadowed Voodoo Spirits are the souls of the troll groups recently slain by the adventurers in the Throne of Thunder while inside the Ruined Approach. Gara'jal appears and pulls these spirits from their bodies when the entire group dies.

__NOTOC__ Shadowed Loa Spirits are loa ghosts summoned by High Priestess Mar'li when she is possessed by the spirit of Gara'jal in Lightning Promenade in the Throne of Thunder. They appear as a spider, snake, and an individual looking like Hakkar the Soulflayer. They pursue a random player. If the spirit moves within 6 yards of its target, it instantly kills them.
Shadowforge Geologists are Dark Iron dwarves found in Echomok Cavern and Dig Three in Uldaman.
Shadowforge Relic Hunters are Dark Iron dwarves found in Echomok Cavern in Uldaman.
Shadowforge Archaeologists are Dark Iron dwarves located in Dig Three in Uldaman.
Shadowforge Darkcasters are Dark Iron dwarves found in Dig Three in Uldaman.
Shadowforge Sharpshooters are Dark Iron dwarves found in Dig Three in Uldaman.
Shadowglen Spitters are podlings located in Socrethar's Rise in .
The Shadowhide Pearltusk has a chance to drop from Invader's Forgotten Treasure, Routed Invader's Crate of Spoils or any of the Master and Commander garrison bosses.
Shadowmane Charger is sold by Ravenspeaker Skeega in Warspear and Shadow-Sage Brakoss in Stormshield, Ashran for .
The Shadowglen Berserkers were members of the Shadowglen tribe and served under Chieftain Krag'jin. They were ultimately wiped out by Illidan and his naga.
The Shadowglen High Priests were members of the Shadowglen tribe and served under Chieftain Krag'jin. They were ultimately wiped out by Illidan and his naga.
The Shadowglen Dark Priests were members of the Shadowglen tribe and served under Chieftain Krag'jin. They were ultimately wiped out by Illidan and his naga.
The Shadowglen Healers were members of the Shadowglen tribe and served under Chieftain Krag'jin. They were ultimately wiped out by Illidan and his naga.
The Shadowglen Dark Healers were members of the Shadowglen tribe and served under Chieftain Krag'jin. They were ultimately wiped out by Illidan and his naga.
Shadowfel Warden is a fel apexis guardian located in Hellfire Citadel.

__NOTOC__ Shadowlord Slaghammer is a Dark Iron dwarf shadow priest sent by Moira Thaurissan to infiltrate the Twilight's Hammer cult in order to pay off his "family debt". When a shadow priest adventurer arrives at the tomb of Tyr below the Tirisfal Glades in search of Xal'atath, Blade of the Black Empire, Slaghammer turns on Twilight Deacon Farthing's Twilight cultists and helps the priest recover the blade.
Shadowfall Canyon is an area in . The pale orcs here have subjugated the spirits of Fire, Earth, and Wind.

__NOTOC__ Shadowgore Darkcasters are male eredar warlocks who serve Akaari Shadowgore at the Shadowgore Citadel. One of them traveled to Dalaran and killed Desmond Gravesorrow before a subtlety rogue in search of intel on Akaari could speak to him. This one can be encountered by all classes.
Shadowgaze Batriders are orcs found riding bats at the Court of Souls in Talador.
Shadowflame Imps are imps attacking Dalaran while it's above Deadwind Pass.

__NOTOC__ Shadowgore Bloodmaidens are female eredar who serve Akaari Shadowgore at the Shadowgore Citadel. One of them traveled to the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran disguised as Akaari in order to lead the rogue adventurer and Valeera Sanguinar on a false trail.
Shadowgore Stalkers are felstalkers patrolling around the Shadowgore Citadel. Some of them are accompanying Shadowgore Bloodmaidens.

Shadowgore Citadel is a Burning Legion fortress floating in the Twisting Nether and which is ruled by the eredar assassin Akaari Shadowgore. Akaari built the citadel on a dead world to hold prisoners and extract knowledge from them, but when the location of the stronghold became known to the rest of the Burning Legion, she made a show of abandoning it. It had become a useless and unhelpful symbol, but it had served its purpose. She would later return to the citadel, but only in secret, and only to prepare for particularly difficult invasions or to interrogate particularly important prisoners. Subtlety rogues seeking to confront Akaari and claim the daggers she wields enlist the aid of an ere

Shadowmane was the mount of Aurius Rivendare. Upon his death, it was claimed by Raemien the Soultaker. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, paladins of the Silver Hand invaded Stratholme to find Rivendare's body and the steed only to be attacked by Raemien. Upon the death knight's death, Shadowmane was taken by the paladins into the Sanctum of Light and they redeemed it into Glowing Reins of the Golden Charger to serve as a mount of the new Highlord.

Shadowguard Voidbenders are void ethereals located at the Seat of the Triumvirate in Eredath.
Shadowguard Champions are void ethereals located at the Seat of the Triumvirate in Eredath.
Shadowguard Riftstalkers are void ethereals located at the Seat of the Triumvirate in Eredath.
Shadowguard Phaseblades are void ethereals located at the Shadowguard Incursion in Eredath. They are accompanied by Enthralled Voidstalkers.
Shadowguard Adepts are void ethereals located at the Shadowguard Incursion in Eredath.
Shadowguard Siphoners are void ethereals located at the Shadowguard Incursion in Eredath.
Shadowcrazed Marsuul are marsuul located at the Isolon Basin in Eredath.
Shadowguard Abyss Callers are void ethereals located in the Umbral Locus in Eredath.

The Shadowforge Looters are deceased Dark Iron dwarves lying around Lotwil Veriatus' abandoned camp in the Dustbowl in the Badlands.

Shadowflame Familiars are imps summoned by Warlock Ritualists and Insidious Defilers in Talador and by Magril the Seer in Tanaan Jungle. They are also summoned by Imp Seers and Imp Charmers during the invasions of the Lunarfall and Frostwall garrisons.
Shadowforged Braziers are braziers found in the Lyceum of Blackrock Depths. They need to be lit by a Shadowforge Torch to open the iron doors to the Iron Hall.
Shadowflame Tricksters are imps summoned by Arinor the Portalmaster in Azsuna during the Legion Assaults.
Shadowguard Void Effusion is looted from Brittle Krokul Chest and Gleaming Footlocker and a reward from Ancestral Arms and Relics of Ascendancy.

Shadowburst Skeletons are skeletal trolls summoned by Bloodfire Necromancers and Bloodhunter Cursecarver in Nazmir.
__NOTOC__ Shadoweye Scouts are goblins, Forsaken, and blood elves located in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.

Shadowguard Subjugators are void ethereals located in the Seat of the Triumvirate. They can be seen corrupting Warp Stalkers.

Shadowprey Village is a port located on the southern end of the coast of Desolace. Primarily a troll fishing village, Shadowprey is also a travel node for Horde adventurers. It lies along the Sar'theris Strand, south of the Valley of Spears. Nearby a representative of the Cenarion Circle, the dryad Selendra, investigates the whereabouts of Zaetar's remains. This village is home to a number of professional troll fishermen, whose catches help supply food to the Ghost Walker Post and are always in high demand. Recently, Blubbergut, a greedy orca, has been feasting upon all the fish near the village making it difficult to catch any and feed the residents.
Shadowshard Fragments drop from Shadowshard Rumblers and Shadowshard Smasher in Maraudon's entrance in Desolace.
Shady Dealers are brokers located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Shadows & Light is a sourcebook for the Warcraft RPG. It was published in 2004. The book is out of print. However, it can still be obtained in PDF format from [http://www.drivethrurpg.com Drive Thru RPG]. Much of the lore in the book appears to be written by an unknown historian or historians on Azeroth. This implied by references throughout the book to the beliefs of other historians and scholars, including Khadgar. It refers to these individuals; beliefs, opinions, and rumors covering a variety of topics in the world of Azeroth. The book includes several short stories.

The Shadowtooth clan (also capitalized as ShadowTooth) is the only known dark troll tribe. They aided the night elves, the Alliance and the Horde in the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Dark trolls may have derived from a single troll tribe given their few numbers. Speaker Ik'nal can be found in Zuldazar on Zandalar. She confirms that the Shadowtooth were wiped out by the Twilight's Hammer during that cult's attack on Hyjal during the Cataclysm. However, the Zandalari keep one representative around as a memento of the past. Ik'nal is now nothing more than a curiosity.
__NOTOC__ The Shady Rest Inn (or simply Shady Rest) was a human-built inn near the border between Dustwallow Marsh and the Southern Barrens.

Shadowthread Cave is in the northwest corner of the Shadowglen in Teldrassil. While it has always been home to the great spiders of Teldrassil, recently the spiders have become increasingly hostile and the cave much more dangerous. The largest spider in the Shadowthread Cave is named Githyiss the Vile, a particularly nasty specimen that has been the bane of more than one inexperienced Kaldorei.
Shadowy Laced Handwraps is a pair of Level 48 quality Cloth Gloves that improve Intellect, Stamina and Haste.

__NOTOC__ Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz is an elite sand troll found in Zul'Farrak. He co-leads the 100 troll assault on the pyramid with Nekrum Gutchewer. He is probably an important religious icon to the Sandfury.
Shadowskin Gloves are created by Leatherworkers and are great for Rogues and Hunters.

Shadowprey Guardians are jungle trolls found at Shadowprey Village on the coast of western Desolace. Each man and woman that defend the village are well geared and have axes. There are many Shadowprey Guardians throughout the village patrolling the streets and stationed at various buildings as well as at the village entrance.
Shadowy Mail Greaves are mail feet armor with Shadow Resistance and a substantial amount of Stamina.

Shahram Dabiri (also known as Shane Dabiri, alias Drake) is Chief of Staff at Blizzard Entertainment.

Shadra'Alor is a settlement built by the forest trolls of the Amani Empire in the Hinterlands. Shadra'Alor was originally controlled by the Witherbark tribe as their main settlement but after the Cataclysm it was occupied by the Vilebranch tribe. The loa Shadra could be summoned here.

Shadowsong Shrine was a ruin-covered hill in western Azshara. It was haunted by the ghosts of the highborne, who also roamed the surrounding landscape looking to quench all intruding life. The shrine shared its name with both Jarod Shadowsong, commander of the resistance during the War of the Ancients and Maiev Shadowsong, older sister of Jarod and the famous warden who was held responsible for the captivity of Illidan Stormrage after his betrayal at Mt. Hyjal. Any connection they have with the shrine is unknown. Since the Cataclysm, the shrine has been removed by Alliance troops from Northwatch and rebuilt as a guard tower. The area has been incorporated into Talrendis Point.

The Shady Nook is located in Ashenvale, south of Raynewood Retreat and east of Greenpaw Village. It is a small valley populated by a small family of bears, who presumably also inhabit the small cave located there.

Shael'dryn is a dryad quest giver located at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale. She considers herself a worthy comedian, with Broll Bearmantle describing her as "a jester of words, a lover of puns". When the Emerald Nightmare attacked Azeroth, Shael'dryn warned other guardians about shadow attackers before becoming a sleeping victim herself.

The Shadowsworn (or the shadowsworn) cult is a collection of demon worshipers working out of the Blasted Lands. They are made up of many races, including orcs, trolls, tauren, Forsaken, humans, goblins, and high elves. They are very to anyone not amongst them. Their leaders are Archmage Allistarj and Lady Sevine. They have control over one of the remaining Altar of Storms left in Azeroth, as well as Serpent's Coil, a large cave system found in the northeastern area of the Blasted Lands. They are speculated to be another off-branch of the Burning Blade, and consequently serve the Shadow Council in aiding the demonic corruption of Azeroth. Shaggy Leggings are leather trousers that give a bonus to intellect and stamina.
Shadowrend Longblade is a one-hand sword that is often a large upgrade for physical dps classes starting in The Outland.
Shakes O'Breen is a human quest giver located in Faldir's Cove in the Arathi Highlands. He is the captain of a crew of Blackwater Raiders pirates and a friend of Skuerto.
Shaffar's Wrappings drop from Nexus-Prince Shaffar in the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun.
Shadowvine Cloak of Infusion is an epic cloak, best suited for healers.

Shadowy Belt is a quest reward from The Undermarket (quest).

The Shadowpine tribe is a troll tribe set in Zeb'Sora, Zeb'Nowa and Zeb'Tela, Ghostlands. Their priests are raising the mummies in the Amani Catacombs to bolster their numbers. They are apparently very skilled at crafting weapons, and Captain Helios states that once they've been dealt with, the Farstriders can focus on Deatholme.

Shadrek is an ethereal quest giver located at Aeris Landing in Nagrand. He is a merchant who is interested in the ivory from the tusks of the native elekk, and will continue to accept ivory until a player reaches Friendly reputation with the Consortium. He assures players that he has permission from the Mag'har and Kurenai to poach the elekk.
Shadowstalker Kaide is a Forsaken quest giver located at Stonebreaker Camp in Terokkar Forest.

__NOTOC__ Shadowsong Amethyst as with other Burning Crusade epic gems, can be mined from Ancient Gem Veins in Hyjal Summit, or drop from trash mobs in the Black Temple and Sunwell Plateau. They can also occasionally be found inside of Brilliant Glass created by Jewelcrafters. The gems crafted from this match blue or red sockets.

Shaffar's Stasis Chamber Key is used to open the Stasis Chamber of Nexus-Prince Shaffar, and summon the void hound Yor in the Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun. Yor can only be summoned if the instance is being run on Heroic Mode. The key is consumed when used.
This item drops from Azgalor during the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

Shadowpine Headhunters are forest trolls found in the Ghostlands.
Shadowpine Hexxers are forest trolls found in the Ghostlands.
Shadowpine Shadowcasters are forest trolls found in the Ghostlands.
Shadowy Assassins are humans found in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. They seem to spawn after they were announced by the Southshore Crier.
Shadowpine Oracles are forest trolls found in the Ghostlands.
Shadowsilk Poacher are poachers that hunted lava spiders in Searing Gorge for the spider silks.

Shady Rest is a small well known town a day's travel south of Ashenvale along the Gold Road. It is named after the inn at its heart, Shady Rest Inn, one of the best known on Kalimdor. The town is renowned not just for its soft beds and warm meals, but also for the famous Shady Rest ale and nightly sing-alongs in the common room. In the years since the inn's construction, the small village has grown around it, including a standing garrison of mercenary troops for hire that help protect the town from centaur and quilboar raids when not otherwise employed. Shake Your Bunny-Maker is part of the Noble Gardener meta-achievement for the Noblegarden world event. This achievement is complicated by the fact that the Spring Flowers have a five minute cooldown, but it is not impossible. When attempting to place bunny ears, ensure that your target is not already wearing bunny ears (Check their buffs! Look for a carrot icon), though this won't trigger a cooldown. If you don't mind a little PvP, you can get this achievement very quickly. Just queue for Arena matches. The cool-down is reset for your Spring Flowers each match, because it's shorter than 10 min.

The Shadowstalkers are spies — whose job description includes assassinations — and are in Northrend by orders of Varimathras. For instance, Shadowstalker Luther was gathering intelligence on some nearby nerubians before he ran into necrolords and had to poison himself rather than be taken as a prisoner. Subsequently, they were fighting the Nerub'ar who were turning Horde soldiers into undead. Shadowstalker Barthus seems to be in charge of the Shadowstalkers in the area.
